defects: Predicate claims pending offer occurs “exactly when” row exists, `status` null, `completedAt` set, log readable. Existing retrieval adds `abandoned_at IS NULL`. An abandoned, completed, readable, unlogged row meets stated predicate but must not be offered. Decision table also omits this reachable state.

Plan says prompt must state missing metrics, but current prompt omits metric line when primary metric is absent; proposed tests only assert summary field and cannot catch absent/misleading prompt text.

Plan requires storage-open failure to yield no offer and run-number warning, but names no implementation point or control for that failure. Existing storage opens throw through all pending-summary entry paths.
